chapters.title: Hello, Computer
chapters.subtitle: The fundamentals: output, variables, decisions and loops.

units.title: First Steps
learn: Show text and numbers with PRINT
Store numbers in variables with LET
Let BASIC do the math
units.goal: Write a program that calculates a result and prints it.

units.title: Jumps & Decisions
learn: Jump to any line with GOTO
Make decisions with IF…THEN
Repeat code with a counter
units.goal: Write a countdown that repeats itself instead of copying lines.

units.title: Loops
learn: Repeat code with FOR and NEXT
Count in steps with STEP
Put loops inside loops
units.goal: Print a whole table with just a few lines.

chapters.title: Working with Data
chapters.subtitle: Store, read and process whole lists of numbers.

units.title: READ & DATA
learn: Keep values inside the program with DATA
Read them one by one with READ
units.goal: Process a list of values without a LET for each one.

units.title: Lists with DIM
learn: Create lists with DIM
Access items by their position
units.goal: Store a list of scores and work with every item.

units.title: Built-in Functions
learn: Round numbers with INT and use ABS and SQR
Random numbers with RND
Math functions: SIN, COS, EXP and LOG
units.goal: Find perfect squares with SQR and INT, and roll virtual dice.

chapters.title: Bigger Programs
chapters.subtitle: Structure larger programs like a real 1960s programmer.

units.title: Subroutines
learn: Reuse code with GOSUB
Come back with RETURN
units.goal: Split a program into clean, reusable parts.

units.title: Your Own Functions
learn: Define functions with DEF FN
Use them in calculations

units.title: Debugging & Style
learn: Find and fix bugs step by step
Write programs others can read

chapters.title: Classic Programs
chapters.subtitle: No new statements, just real programming: the problems everyone solved in BASIC.

units.title: Patterns & Tables
learn: Draw shapes with PRINT and loops
Line up neat tables with commas
Plan a program before you write it
units.goal: Print a perfectly centered pyramid of stars.

units.title: Searching & Sorting
learn: Find the biggest and smallest value and where it is
Search a list for a number
Sort a list with bubble sort
units.goal: Sort a messy list of numbers from smallest to biggest.

units.title: Simulations
learn: Simulate dice and coins with RND
Try every possibility with nested loops
Count results with lists
units.goal: Find out exactly how often each sum comes up with three dice.

chapters.title: Beyond 1964
chapters.subtitle: What came after the first BASIC, and where to go from here.

units.title: INPUT: Talking Back
learn: Ask the user for numbers with INPUT
Check input and ask again
Keep asking until a stop value
units.goal: Write a calculator that reacts to what the user types.

units.title: Text & Matrices
learn: Store words in text variables like N$
Use text in decisions and DATA
Work with whole lists using MAT
units.goal: Build a small quiz that stores questions as text.

units.title: From BASIC to Today
learn: How BASIC spread to home computers like the Commodore 64
The same ideas in Python
What to learn next
units.goal: See how everything you learned carries over to modern languages.
